island.label: Duri island
island.handle: Duri, tucked away. Hover to peek.

music.name: Music
music.description: See and control what's playing in any media app.

timer.name: Timer
timer.description: Count down, with several timers at once.

sessions.name: Sessions
sessions.description: Follow your Claude Code and Codex sessions.

clipboard.name: Clipboard
clipboard.description: Everything you copied: text, images and files.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Jot things down without leaving what you are doing.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Shows the volume level in the island when it changes.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: Windows notifications in the island, and a quick confirmation when you copy.

keys.name: Lock Keys
keys.description: Shows Caps Lock, Insert and Scroll Lock in the island when you press them.

bluetooth.name: Bluetooth
bluetooth.description: Shows the battery of your connected Bluetooth devices, warns you when one runs low, and tells you when one connects or disconnects.

battery.name: Battery
battery.description: Shows when you plug the charger in or out, and warns you when the battery runs low.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Shows the screen brightness in the island when it changes, with a slider to adjust it.

privacy.name: Camera and Microphone
privacy.description: Shows a badge beside the island while an app uses the camera or microphone, and says which app started.

music.nothingPlayingHint: Play something in Spotify, your browser or any media app.

settings.launchAtLoginHint: Start Duri when you sign in to Windows.
settings.usageHint: Hover the island to peek, click to open an app. Drag it up to tuck it away into a small handle; drag it down or right-click it to bring it back.
settings.appsHint: Turn off apps you don't need. They disappear from the island.
settings.license: Open source under the MIT License.
settings.claudeConnected: Connected. New Claude Code sessions report to Duri.
settings.claudeNotConnected: Adds hooks to ~/.claude/settings.json and keeps a backup. Your own hooks stay untouched.
settings.codexHint: Sessions in ~/.codex/sessions are picked up automatically.
settings.serverDown: Duri couldn’t open port 47321, so Claude Code can’t reach it. Close whatever uses that port and restart Duri.
settings.islandStyleHint: Attached hangs from the top edge of the screen, like a notch.
settings.replaceFlyoutHint: The volume keys show Duri’s indicator instead of the Windows popup.
settings.idleInfoHint: What the pill shows when nothing is going on.
settings.clockFormatHint: Automatic follows the time format set in Windows.
settings.transparencyHint: Lets the desktop show through the island.
settings.hideInFullscreenHint: Hides the island while a fullscreen app, game or video is in front. Volume and lock key indicators still show.
settings.claudePermissionsHint: Allow or deny Claude Code's requests from the island. Unanswered ones go back to the terminal after 2 minutes.
settings.shortcutsHint: Click a shortcut and press new keys. Backspace turns it off.
settings.shortcutTaken: Another app uses this shortcut. Pick a different one.
settings.autoHideHint: Like an auto-hiding taskbar: it stays out of sight until you move the pointer to the top of the screen. Alerts and the volume and lock key indicators still show.

sessions.emptyHint: Start Claude Code or Codex and it shows up here.
sessions.connectHint: Duri adds a few hooks to Claude Code’s settings so it can follow your sessions. Your own hooks stay as they are.

clipboard.emptyHint: Copy text, an image or files and they show up here. Click one to paste it where you were typing.

notes.emptyHint: Click + to write one. Notes save as you type.

updates.autoHint: Duri looks for new versions on GitHub and tells you. Nothing installs without you.
updates.failed: Couldn’t check for updates. Try again later.
updates.restartHint: Duri restarts after the update. Your notes, clips and timers stay.
updates.notifyBody: Open Settings › About to install it.

notifications.emptyHint: Notifications from your apps show up here as they arrive.
notifications.deniedHint: Allow apps to access your notifications in Windows Settings › Privacy & security › Notifications.
notifications.unavailable: This version of Windows doesn't let apps read notifications.

bluetooth.noneHint: Connect one in Windows Bluetooth settings.

privacy.none: No app is using the camera or microphone
